stations.name: Workbench
stations.why: Tools from paper, powder and wire, pouches and furniture; ROADMAP's first station

stations.name: Smithy
stations.why: Blades and thrown tools from steel, smelting salvage, repair and upgrade. The small forge at home stops at fine

stations.name: Kitchen (VF Hearth & Harvest)
stations.why: VF's pot, oven and prep table with the Leaf's dishes as data recipes; no new kitchen block

stations.why: Medicine, antidotes and coatings were spread over the workbench; one table for the Suzuran line, the hospital night shift and Forest of Death supplies

stations.name: Sealing Desk
stations.why: Storage scrolls and blank scrolls in the beta (the scroll shop's desk); advanced tags from Chunin, with one at home

stations.name: Tailor's Table
